EP.name: EPO Publication Server
EP.note: Primary automated source for EP publication documents.

JP.name: J-PlatPat
JP.note: Official service supports document-unit PDF download; no stable public PDF API is assumed by V1.

JP.name: JPO Patent Information Retrieval API
JP.note: Registered API can retrieve Japanese application documents and metadata; this is not treated as a gazette-PDF endpoint.

CN.name: CNIPA Patent Publication System
CN.note: Official publication system can download published claims/specification and granted patent documents.

CN.name: CNIPA IP Data Public Service System
CN.note: Registered data-resource service is the official route for larger-scale data acquisition.

WO.name: WIPO PATENTSCOPE
WO.note: Official PCT PDF access. V1 does not robot-scrape PATENTSCOPE.

WO.name: WIPO PCT Data Services
WO.note: Programmatic batch document access is available under WIPO data-product/API terms.

US.name: USPTO
US.note: Official publication search/download source; dedicated automated adapter is deferred.

KR.name: KIPRIS
KR.note: Official Korean patent information service; dedicated automated adapter is deferred.
